definitions: Collaboration and cooperation among individuals are essential for achieving success or a desired outcome.
Working together effectively is the key to realizing ambitious goals.
examples: Our startup really took off; they say teamwork makes the dream work, and it's true for us.
The project was a huge success, proving that they say teamwork makes the dream work.
If we want to finish this on time, we need to remember they say teamwork makes the dream work.
lemma: they say teamwork makes the dream work
synonyms: two heads are better than one
